caption: The drawing shows a large, rectangular ironwork panel with intricate, symmetrical patterns. The ironwork is depicted in grey tones with subtle shading, giving it a metallic appearance. The main design inside the rectangle is composed of scrolling vines and curves, radiating from a central quatrefoil (a four-lobed floral shape) with a small flower at its center. Around the central quatrefoil are four additional reference points, each with a similar smaller quatrefoil shape, all interconnected by elaborate swirling and curling lines resembling foliage and floral motifs. The border of the main panel is a simple, straight-lined rectangular frame, and at the top center of the drawing is a separate ornamental crest, also rendered in grey tones, featuring more elaborate, larger curling leaves and a symmetrical arrangement of scrolls and foliate details. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with some subtle variations in tone, and the overall composition is centralized on the page.
title: Cast Iron Gate
